parsed.title: Run the search before the customer does
parsed.hook: The referral got your name. The phone search can decide whether you get the call.
parsed.angle: Turn word of mouth into visible proof with one private-browser check and one small fix.
parsed.caption:
Word of mouth did its job.

Then the customer searched your name.

That search can expose a quiet leak: stale photos, missing profile details, or a review nobody answered.

Run this check tonight:

Open a private tab.
Search your business name plus your town.
Find the weakest proof.
Fix one item.

The two-year-old job photo has served with honor. It can retire from the front line.

Repeat the check weekly until the public record looks like the work your crew already does.

#OwnerOperator #TradeBusiness #LocalReputation
parsed.cta: Save this for the next ten-minute gap between jobs.
parsed.alt_text: Four-slide checklist showing trade business owners how to search their business in a private browser, inspect their public proof, identify the weakest area, and make one small update.

slides.headline: The referral got your name
slides.body: The phone search can decide whether you get the call. Treat it like a second front door.

slides.headline: Run the driveway search
slides.body: Open a private browser tab. Search your business name plus your town. Look at the result like a stranger would.

slides.headline: Find the weakest proof
slides.body: Check for missing profile details, stale job photos, old reviews, or reviews with no reply. Pick one. Not all four.

slides.headline: Make one visible fix
slides.body: Add recent job photos, complete one missing field, or answer one review calmly and factually. Then get back to the real work.

evidence.claim: A referral may lead to online research rather than directly to a call.
evidence.quote: The referral gets you into the research. It no longer skips it.

evidence.claim: Recent reviews, real work photos, and calm review responses can shape what a prospective customer sees.
evidence.quote: A Google profile with a real star rating, recent reviews, photos of actual local work, and calm answers to the people who complained: that's a green light.

evidence.claim: Owners can inspect their public presence by searching their business name and town in a private browser tab.
evidence.quote: Grab your phone, open a private browser tab, and search your business name plus your town.

evidence.claim: The suggested check includes profile completeness and photo recency.
evidence.quote: First: what actually loads. Is the profile yours, is it complete, and are the photos recent, or is the newest proof of your work older than your newest truck?
